confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Berlin price levels for July 2026; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and cafe anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely by district, booking timing and major events. Beer is a 0.5 L draft and wine a 0.2 L glass; cocktail and wine are direct estimates, not derived from beer. FX value 0.7002 (2026-10-14) comes from web search summaries of the RBA table, not the RBA page itself, and those summaries were inconsistent about dates; verify before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Berlin-specific general knowledge, sanity-checked against other large German cities; Munich and Hamburg generally sit higher, especially for hotels. No proxy city was used.
